categories.label: Rodent / Pest
categories.definition: Rodent complaints (rat/mouse sightings, signs of rodents, conditions attracting rodents) plus housing 'Unsanitary Condition' complaints with the descriptor 'Pests'.

categories.label: Noise - Residential
categories.definition: Noise complaints about residential buildings (loud music, banging, talking, etc.).

categories.label: Heat & Hot Water
categories.definition: Housing complaints about missing heat or hot water.

categories.label: Illegal Parking
categories.definition: Illegal parking complaints (hydrants, bike lanes, double parking, etc.).

categories.label: Blocked Driveway
categories.definition: Complaints about vehicles blocking a driveway.

categories.label: Sanitation / Dirty Conditions
categories.definition: Dirty streets and lots, sanitation conditions, and illegal dumping.
